policy: Every await expression is explicitly configured. ConfigureAwait(false) is mandatory for services, controllers, persistence, diagnostics, background work and component methods that do not require renderer affinity. ConfigureAwait(true) is allowed only inside OnAfterRenderAsync. await using remains a language-level asynchronous-disposal construct; an awaited initializer inside it must still be explicitly configured. Existing ConfiguredTaskAwaitable values are already configured by their caller.
